description: A library module for parsing and extracting information from devicetree source files (.dts). Defines classes such as DT, Node, Property, and related enums and exceptions, with methods for handling devicetree nodes, properties, and references.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in the devicetree, with attributes like name, unit_addr, props, nodes, labels, parent, path, and dt.

classes.name: Type
classes.description: Enum defining property data types such as EMPTY, BYTES, NUM, NUMS, STRING, STRINGS, PATH, PHANDLE, PHANDLES, PHANDLES_AND_NUMS, COMPOUND.

classes.name: _MarkerType
classes.description: Enum for marker types in property values, including PATH, PHANDLE, LABEL, UINT8, UINT16, UINT32, UINT64, STRING.

classes.name: Property
classes.description: Represents a property of a devicetree node, with attributes like name, value, type, labels, offset_labels, and methods for converting to various data types.

classes.name: _T
classes.description: Enum for token IDs used by the devicetree lexer.

classes.name: _FileStackElt
classes.description: NamedTuple for maintaining include stack information during parsing.

classes.name: _Token
classes.description: NamedTuple representing a lexer token with id and value.

classes.name: DT
classes.description: Main class representing a parsed devicetree, with methods for parsing files, accessing nodes, moving nodes, iterating over nodes, and generating string representations.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for DT, Node, Property classes, initializing from source files or parameters.

methods.name: node_iter
methods.description: Generator for iterating over all nodes in the devicetree.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the devicetree or node in DTS format.

methods.name: get_node
methods.description: Retrieves a node by path or alias, raising DTError if not found.

methods.name: has_node
methods.description: Checks existence of a node by path or alias.

methods.name: move_node
methods.description: Moves a node to a new path within the devicetree.
